issues.description: The solution makes Course.addRating(stars:) private, but the problem statement and the template expect this instance method to be callable from other files (e.g., Client calls swiftCourse.addRating). Declaring it private restricts access to the declaration/file scope and will prevent Client or other files in the module from calling it, causing a compilation/accessibility mismatch.
issues.suggestedFix: Make addRating(stars:) non-private so it is accessible where needed (remove the private modifier or use internal/public access). For example, change 'private func addRating(stars: Int)' to 'func addRating(stars: Int)' so Client.swift and tests can call it.
